lea.text: On Dominaria, Hurloon minotaurs came to Northern Aerona from Stahaan after glaciers drove them out. Much later the Hurloon and the Talruum were devastated in the Phyrexian Invasion.

leg.text: Dominaria's oldest story is one of dragons: the Ur-Dragon brushes past the plane and spawns the elder dragons, and Nicol Bolas and Ugin hatch together and witness the murder of their sister Merrevia Sal. Humanity then begins hunting the fledgling dragons, and Bolas tricks the dragon-killers into a feud and takes over as their supreme leader.

The Elder Dragon War follows, as Bolas manipulates the dragon clans against each other and the war spreads across the seas, leaving only a few dragons alive. Human wizards later overthrow the Primeval Dragons and steal their powers, until Greensleeves and Gull defeat the alliance of wizards.

ice.text: The Sylex Blast that ends the Brothers' War changes Dominaria's climate and begins the Ice Age. Lhurgoyfs spread across the plane, and Freyalise helps the elves survive and is deified by them.

Kjeldor and Balduvia set aside their feud to face the necromancer Lim-Dul, while Tevesh Szat plans to leave Dominaria in eternal slumber under ice. Freyalise fights Szat on Azoria and is blinded by him, and she arms Jaeuhl Carthalion to expel him.
Finally Freyalise casts the World Spell to end the Ice Age, though it brings flooding and climate change, and she leaves Dominaria afterward.

usg.text: Dominaria's deep past is troubled by Yawgmoth, who usurps the Thran Empire and leads it into civil war and collapse. When Urza and Mishra take the powerstone they accidentally reopen the portal to Phyrexia, and Yawgmoth sends Gix to scout.

Gix manipulates both sides of the Brothers' War and compleates Mishra, and when Urza realizes it he begins a lifelong hunt for retribution against Phyrexia and Yawgmoth. Grieving after the Sacrifice at Koilos, Urza resolves to take the lead in the war rather than only react to it.

inv.text: The sky splits and the Phyrexian Invasion begins in 4205 AR after Yawgmoth's millennia of planning, with the world looking to Urza for defense. Urza convinces many Dominarians to set aside their differences, and the Coalition he organizes fights back.

Teferi phases north-western Jamuraa and part of Shiv out of existence, and the Rathi Overlay merges Rath with Dominaria, bringing its Phyrexian legions. Freyalise returns to defend the plane as one of Urza's Nine Titans.

Yawgmoth then arrives as a gigantic Black Cloud of Death, killing billions. Only the Legacy Weapon, completed when Urza has Gerrard place his powerstone eyes in Karn's chest, saves the plane and destroys Yawgmoth, and Karn returns as a planeswalker.

pls.text: To save Dominaria, nine planeswalkers seek the annihilation of Phyrexia itself, while portions of Rath begin appearing on the plane and bring Phyrexian reinforcements as Urza and Dominaria's armies lose ground. Multani observes that Rath's overlay is interfering with the Aether.

apc.text: All of Dominaria recoils as Yawgmoth and his retainers arrive, and the final battle begins as the kavu emerge from their ancient nests. Channeling the Null Moon's mana fails to kill him at first.

In the end Urza has Gerrard place his powerstone eyes in Karn's chest, completing the Legacy, and light eradicates Yawgmoth's essence. Gerrard and Urza die in the Weapon's activation, the Weatherlight crashes, and Karn becomes a planeswalker.
Rath's overlay also leaves a mark on the land, as the merge disrupts magic and causes mutations that produce the Volvers.

tsp.text: Over two hundred years after Phyrexia's invasion, Dominaria's timeline is shredded as time rifts open across the plane, bringing visitors from the past and future and making natives disappear. The Sylex Blast had created the first known rift, and Teferi's phasing of Zhalfir and Shiv tore more, while mana drains into the rifts and Dominaria withers.

Legendary planeswalkers sacrifice their sparks or lives to close the rifts, among them Freyalise at Keld, Windgrace at the Stronghold and Teferi at Shiv. Jeska's final sacrifice closes the last rift over Otaria and brings the Great Mending, after which planeswalkers lose their immortality and godlike powers.

fut.text: After the Great Mending heals Dominaria's fractures, the plane is reinfused with mana, and elementals flourish as new forms of life adapt to the land.
Jeska returns to Dominaria seeking vengeance for Karn as Leshrac returns.

m11.text: A temporal disaster sweeps across Dominaria and strands creatures out of time.

dom.text: Dominaria is changed by the Mending, which makes Masrath ascend as a planeswalker. Afterward a Cabal group tries to summon Kuberr but accidentally frees the demonlord Belzenlok from the Abyss, who begins rewriting history with himself as lead and subjugates much of the plane.

Gideon arrives on Dominaria wounded after Amonkhet, with Liliana, Chandra and Nissa, and he and Liliana begin a mission to kill Belzenlok, the final demon holding Liliana's contract. The Weatherlight crew defeats the Cabal's stronghold, and Gideon kills Belzenlok with the Blackblade.

Bolas then inherits Liliana's contract and takes her off Dominaria. In the story's last chapters Karn uncovers the Sylex and Jhoira asks Teferi to take back the Mana Rig locket holding his spark, so that he can help kill Bolas.

m19.text: In a vision, Ugin shifts back to Dominaria and finds that the birth mountain now holds a city and temple with curved horns, which tells him Nicol rules there. Atop the mountain he confronts Nicol about his mind-manipulation and the pointlessness of his conquests and reveals he is a planeswalker, but Ugin cannot explain the spark and leaves in fury and grief.
Bolas tells it differently, claiming he alone dared to land on the ground and named the world Dominaria, and that he drove Arcades into retreat before Ugin returned.

m21.text: Dominaria appears on this set's cards as the plane of Tormod's Crypt.

mh2.text: Researchers at Riptide Laboratory, working with the best of intentions, unwittingly unleash a plague of troubles on Dominaria. On this set's cards it is also the plane where Yavimaya lies and which a false god tore magic from.

j21.text: On this set's cards Dominaria is a plane whose wonders include a system of life with prey and predators.

dmu.text: A second Phyrexian invasion begins in 4562 AR, when Sheoldred arrives through the Planar Bridge and allies with the Society of Mishra, Rona and a resurrected Ertai. Phyrexians topple tributes to Serra, and the enemy is already on Dominaria as conflict nears.

At the Battle of the Mana Rig, Sheoldred leads the attack on a dragon engine and captures Karn, and Ajani is revealed as a sleeper agent who kills Jaya Ballard. Jaya had accepted that she might die for Dominaria, and Jodah fights as a leader of the New Coalition and delivers her eulogy.

The bridge then carries Sheoldred, Ajani and Karn away from the exploding Mana Rig back to New Phyrexia, and a month later Sheoldred returns with New Phyrexia's full might, so that hundreds of battles erupt across Dominaria.
